verdict.rationale: Fenwick publishes specific named AI tools beyond marketing mentions, including an AI litigation research tool that surfaces uncited relevant cases from a brief and an AI-based due diligence tool that extracts/summarizes contract provisions, both hosted under a dedicated 'artificial intelligence tools' page, plus Fenwick Labs describing its own custom-built legal tech products. Missing for 10: named branding/product names for the AI tools (they're described functionally, not by proprietary name), independent/third-party verification of these tools' real-world use, and a standalone AI governance/ethics policy statement.
